subject: Virtual onsite logistics — adaptive slot routing & eval ownership
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Dao <samir.dao@brightlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Virtual onsite — full loop options (two parallel tracks)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak with us. Wed like to run a compact virtual onsite (full loop) next week that keeps the total candidate-facing time under 3.5 hours. To reduce idle waits were proposing two parallel tracks (A/B) that run overlapping 45–60 minute slots; youll rotate between them so interviewers stay on schedule.

Proposed windows (your timezone: PST):
- Option 1 — Wed Mar 3, 10:00–13:30 (Track A/B interleaved)
- Option 2 — Thu Mar 4, 12:00–15:30 (slightly later start)

If either works, tell us which you prefer and any hard constraints (lunch, school pickup, other). Ive attached your latest resume we pulled from your recruiter and an initial agenda (v1).

High level flow:
- Intro / hiring manager (15)
- Two technical interviews (60 + 45, different areas) across parallel tracks
- Systems design (60)
- Leadership / culture (30)
- 30-minute buffer + 30-minute post-loop debrief (interviewers only)

Were aiming to assign clear eval owners for each rubric (so no duplicated scoring). If youd prefer a shorter day, we can compress to three 45-min technical sessions and skip leadership.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Recruiting Partner — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

Attachments: samir_dao_resume.pdf, full_loop_agenda_v1.pdf

- 10:50–11:35 — Track B: Systems deep-dive (Mina) [eval owner: Mina]

- Eval owners: Marcus (Tech A & Tech B), Mina (Systems), Laura (Leadership), Rachel (overall/hiring manager).
- Post-loop debrief: 14:15–14:45 (internal only) — please keep this slot blocked; well close the loop quickly.

Thanks —
